title: docs(types,changeset): correct stale onRowClick text
body:
Fixes #10074

Corrects two stale text sites:

1. `packages/types/src/data-display.ts:1383` docblock paraphrase — restored the `recordDrillEnabled` gate that the code (`ObjectDataTable.tsx:1043`) and the sibling docblock (`objectql.ts:4572`) already carry.
2. `.changeset/9462-row-click-modifier-payload-forward.md:35-37` — the sentence claiming `ObjectDataTableSchema.onRowClick` "still declaring one parameter ... reported separately" was stale; that declaration was widened by objectui#9799 (`objectql.ts:4592`). Rewrote the sentence to say so.

Text only, `Clause-②: no`. Added an empty-frontmatter changeset (`.changeset/10074-doc-changeset-text.md`) per `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, since `data-display.ts` is published source of `@object-ui/types`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
两处纯文本更正:一是 `data-display.ts` 里对 `ObjectDataTable` 转发 `onRowClick` 的转述漏掉了 `recordDrillEnabled` 门控条件,现按同文件里 `objectql.ts` 的完整引用模型补全;二是 9462 号 changeset 里说 `ObjectDataTableSchema.onRowClick` "仍是单参数、另案处理" 已过期——该声明已被 #9799 拓宽为双参数,现改为如实陈述。

**为什么改**
这两处文字与今天 `origin/main` 上的真实代码不符,前者会误导读者以为该 fallback 无条件生效,后者的现在时表述一旦下个版本发布会被原样冻进 CHANGELOG,届时更难纠正。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
零风险:仅文档/changeset 文字,不触碰任何运行时代码或类型声明本身;`type-check` 与全部改动相关门禁均绿。回滚即 revert 本 PR。

**席位意见**
(留空,交维护者/PM 定稿)

**你要做的**
审阅两处文字更正是否准确;确认无误后可直接合并。
